sources.label: Devin Lawrence Reynolds: about the artist

biography: Devin Lawrence Reynolds is a contemporary painter in Tacoma working across still life, floral and figurative subjects. He builds on traditional painting technique to explore identity, memory, time and mortality.

His still lifes treat ordinary objects as symbols of memory, luck and labour; his floral paintings consider growth, structure and impermanence; and his figures explore courage, vulnerability and transformation.
